# Shared typography

Copied unchanged from the pinned WHAT I BE project.

- English headings: DM Serif Display (400). See DM-Serif-Display-OFL.txt.
- English body: DM Sans (variable). See DM-Sans-OFL.txt.
- Korean: S-Core Dream (regular and medium). See S-Core-Dream-README.md.

The same font stack is used by UI controls, tables, dialogs and SVG diagrams.
